lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਕੀਰਤ ਜੋ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਮੁੜਿ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kav keerat jo sa(n)t charan muR laagahi tinh kaam krodh jam ko nahee traas ||
lines.translation: So speaks Keerat the poet: those who grasp hold of the feet of the Saints, are not afraid of death, sexual desire or anger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਕੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiv a(n)gad a(n)g sa(n)g naanak gur tiv gur amaradaas kai gur raamadaas ||1||
lines.translation: Just as Guru Nanak was part and parcel, life and limb with Guru Angad, so is Guru Amar Daas one with Guru Raam Daas. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਯਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin satigur sev padaarath paayau nis baasur har charan nivaas ||
lines.translation: Whoever serves the True Guru obtains the treasure; night and day, he dwells at the Lord's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਘਨ ਭਾਇ ਭਉ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਲੀਆਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa te sa(n)gat saghan bhaai bhau maanahi tum maleeaagar pragat subaas ||
lines.translation: And so, the entire Sangat loves, fears and respects You. You are the sandalwood tree; Your fragrance spreads gloriously far and wide.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਿਲੋਚਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਉਪਜੵੋ ਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhroo prahalaad kabeer tilochan naam lait upajyo j pragaas ||
lines.translation: Dhroo, Prahlaad, Kabeer and Trilochan chanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and His Illumination radiantly shines forth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪਿਖਤ ਅਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jih pikhat at hoi rahas man soee sa(n)t sahaar guroo raamadaas ||2||
lines.translation: Seeing Him, the mind is totally delighted; Guru Raam Daas is the Helper and Support of the Saints. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾਨੵਉ ਕੀਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam nira(n)jan jaany keenee bhagat prem liv laaee ||
lines.translation: Guru Nanak realized the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. He was lovingly attuned to loving devotional worship of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਯੋ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa te a(n)gad a(n)g sa(n)g bhayo saair tin sabad surat kee neev rakhaaee ||
lines.translation: Gur Angad was with Him, life and limb, like the ocean; He showered His consciousness with the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਛੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur amaradaas kee akath kathaa hai ik jeeh kachh kahee na jaaee ||
lines.translation: The Unspoken Speech of Guru Amar Daas cannot be expressed with only one tongue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਢੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਸਕਲ ਤਾਰਣ ਕਉ ਅਬ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੀ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sodhee srist sakal taaran kau ab gur raamadaas kau milee badaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Guru Raam Daas of the Sodhi dynasty has now been blessed with Glorious Greatness, to carry the whole world across. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਭਰੇ ਏਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham avagun bhare ek gun naahee a(n)mrit chhaad bikhai bikh khaaee ||
lines.translation: I am overflowing with sins and demerits; I have no merits or virtues at all. I abandoned the Ambrosial Nectar, and I drank poison instead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਯਾ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਪੈ ਭੂਲੇ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maayaa moh bharam pai bhoole sut daaraa siu preet lagaaee ||
lines.translation: I am attached to Maya, and deluded by doubt; I have fallen in love with my children and spouse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਉਤਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਿਹ ਮਿਲੰਤ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik utam pa(n)th sunio gur sa(n)gat tih mila(n)t jam traas mitaaee ||
lines.translation: I have heard that the most exalted Path of all is the Sangat, the Guru's Congregation. Joining it, the fear of death is taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਭਾਟ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੫੮॥
lines.transliteration: ik aradaas bhaat keerat kee gur raamadaas raakhahu saranaaee ||4||58||
lines.translation: Keerat the poet offers this one prayer: O Guru Raam Daas, save me! Take me into Your Sanctuary! ||4||58||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਮਲਿ ਬਿਵਸਿ ਕੀਅਉ ਕਾਮੁ ਗਹਿ ਕੇਸ ਪਛਾੜੵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohu mal bivas keeau kaam gahi kes pachhaaRy ||
lines.translation: He has crushed and overpowered emotional attachment. He seized sexual desire by the hair, and threw it down.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਖੰਡਿ ਪਰਚੰਡਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਪਮਾਨ ਸਿਉ ਝਾੜੵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: krodh kha(n)d paracha(n)d lobh apamaan siu jhaaRy ||
lines.translation: With His Power, He cut anger into pieces, and sent greed away in disgrace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਮੰਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam kaal kar joR hukam jo hoi s ma(n)nai ||
lines.translation: Life and death, with palms pressed together, respect and obey the Hukam of His Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੰਧਿਅਉ ਸਿਖ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhav saagar ba(n)dhiau sikh taare suprasa(n)nai ||
lines.translation: He brought the terrifying world-ocean under His Control; by His Pleasure, He carried His Sikhs across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਆਤਪਤੁ ਸਚੌ ਤਖਤੁ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸੰਜੁਤੁ ਬਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sir aatapat sachau takhat jog bhog sa(n)jut bal ||
lines.translation: He is seated upon the Throne of Truth, with the canopy above His Head; He is embellished with the powers of Yoga and the enjoyment of pleasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਚੁ ਸਲੵ ਭਣਿ ਤੂ ਅਟਲੁ ਰਾਜਿ ਅਭਗੁ ਦਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur raamadaas sach saly bhan too atal raaj abhag dal ||1||
lines.translation: So speaks SALL the poet: O Guru Raam Daas, Your sovereign power is eternal and unbreakable; Your army is invincible. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: too satigur chahu jugee aap aape paramesar ||
lines.translation: You are the True Guru, throughout the four ages; You Yourself are the Transcendent Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵੰਤ ਧੁਰਹ ਧੁਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar saadhik sidh sikh seva(n)t dhurah dhur ||
lines.translation: The angelic beings, seekers, Siddhas and Sikhs have served You, since the very beginning of time.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਲੋਅਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad anaad kalaa dhaaree trihu loah ||
lines.translation: You are the Primal Lord God, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages; Your Power supports the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਨਿਗਮ ਉਧਰਣ ਜਰਾ ਜੰਮਿਹਿ ਆਰੋਅਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam nigam udharan jaraa ja(n)mihi aaroah ||
lines.translation: You are Inaccessible; You are the Saving Grace of the Vedas. You have conquered old age and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਥਪਿਅਉ ਪਰਗਾਮੀ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur amaradaas thir thapiau paragaamee taaran taran ||
lines.translation: Guru Amar Daas has permanently established You; You are the Emancipator, to carry all across to the other side.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਘ ਅੰਤਕ ਬਦੈ ਨ ਸਲੵ ਕਵਿ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣ ॥੨॥੬੦॥
lines.transliteration: agh a(n)tak badai na saly kav gur raamadaas teree saran ||2||60||
lines.translation: So speaks SALL the poet: O Guru Raam Daas, You are the Destroyer of sins; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||60||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਪੰਜਵੇ ਕੇ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: savaeee mahale pa(n)jave ke 5 ||
lines.translation: Swaiyas In Praise Of The Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰੰ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਚਲੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: simara(n) soee purakh achal abinaasee ||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Primal Lord God, Eternal and Imperishable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis simarat duramat mal naasee ||
lines.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, the filth of evil-mindedness is eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਰਿਦਿ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur charan kaval rid dhaara(n) ||
lines.translation: I enshrine the Lotus Feet of the True Guru within my heart.
